name: Stiff Algae Brush (Toothbrush)
description: The hobbyist classic: a stiff-bristled brush (an old toothbrush) worked into the crevices of rocks + driftwood to dislodge tufted black-beard and hair algae a flat scraper can't reach. Hardscape-focused — it shifts the tufted reds + strands but isn't the right tool for hard glass green-spot. effectiveness (0.55) + reachMm (20) are MODELLED game-tuning weights, not product specs.
notes: Brush dislodges BBA + hair tufts so they lift off in the water flow; remove a rock to a bucket of tank water and spot-treat with liquid carbon for the stubborn bases SAEs don't finish.
